briefTitle: A Study of Mevrometostat for Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory SCLC, Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer, and Follicular Lymphoma

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histological or cytological diagnosis of castration resistant prostate cancer.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial is out of scope because it is limited to castration-resistant prostate cancer, small cell lung cancer, and follicular lymphoma, rather than non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
